name: Moonkin Form
description: Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form.  While in this form the armor contribution from items is increased by 360% [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Druid: Moonfire costs 50% less mana and deals 100% more damage over time, your periodic damage spells can deal critical periodic damage, you gain (60 * 3) spell damage] and all party members within 30 yards have their spell critical chance increased by 3%.  [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Druid: The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted / The Moonkin can only cast Balance spells while shapeshifted.] [Reduces all threat from Arcane and Nature spells by 0% while in this form]The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
buff_text: Immune to Polymorph effects.  Armor contribution from items is increased by 360%.
